articleSummary: Sylvatic yellow fever virus vectors captured in urban forest fragments of Serra da Cantareira, São Paulo State, fed predominantly on humans during and after the 2017–2018 outbreak. Nanopore sequencing of 143 blood-engorged females identified vertebrate hosts in 107 samples (74.8%), with human blood accounting for 82 meals (76.6% of identified meals). A complete yellow fever virus genome was recovered from an engorged Haemagogus leucocelaenus containing human blood, confirming active circulation in the area. The study, conducted in Alberto Löfgren State Park (PEAL) within Serra da Cantareira, analyzed 5,001 female mosquitoes collected December 2017–March 2020; 143 were blood-fed. Mammals contributed 83.2% of meals, birds 10.3%, and multiple-host meals 6.5%. Among Hg leucocelaenus, 35 of 37 meals were human; Hg capricornii (2 specimens) were 100% human. Findings indicate spillover risk to São Paulo city and underscore sustained vaccination and surveillance in peri-urban areas.

Vaccination remains foundational: seasonal flu vaccine for ≥6 months, plus the XFG mRNA COVID-19 vaccine for eligible 6 months–11 years old, to reduce hospitalizations and transmission. A multi-pronged approach—vaccination, hygiene, early recognition, timely treatment, and adherence—is essential.

articleHeadline: EM&I: Emergence of a Distinct Evolutionary Cluster of Clade 2.3.4.4b H5 Viruses in China during 2024-2025 with Rapid Evolution and Antigenic Divergence
articleSummary: China experienced emergence of a distinct evolutionary cluster within clade 2.3.4.4b H5 viruses during 2024–2025, designated the G2-derived emerging cluster (G2-EC). The study analyzed 18 H5 isolates from 2024–2025 plus publicly available sequences, revealing a separate G2-EC lineage with HA substitutions concentrated in antigenic regions and a higher HA evolutionary rate in 2024–2025 than earlier periods. G2-EC shows marked antigenic divergence from the Re14 vaccine strain, with 4–32-fold reductions in hemagglutination inhibition titres. Genomic analyses show acquisition of the PB1 segment from a distinct background and the rise of H5N6 strains sharing a similar backbone but different NA, indicating sequential reassortment. In SPF chickens, G2-EC viruses retained high pathogenicity and efficient direct-contact transmission, while lethality in mice remained limited. The findings call for continued genomic and antigenic surveillance of clade 2.3.4.4b H5.

articleHeadlineTranslated: More departments report an increase in suspected dengue cases.
articleHeadline: Más departamentos muestran incremento de casos sospechosos de dengue
articleSummary: Dengue notifications rose 29% across Paraguay, extending beyond Asunción and Villa Hayes to Central, Caaguazú, Cordillera, San Pedro, and Amambay. The virus remains largely non-circulating, with 235 weekly suspected cases and 293 positive dengue cases in 2026. In the last 21 days, no new dengue cases, outbreaks, or deaths, and no new chikungunya activity. Health authorities urge eliminating mosquito breeding sites after rains and routine vector-control, including removing standing water. El Niño-driven rains call for discarding containers, covering water storage, and using chlorine as needed. Paraguay remains malaria-free since 2011, certified by WHO in 2018; vigilance for imported malaria and strengthened border surveillance are emphasized to prevent reintroduction ahead of World Malaria Day.
